segment_coverage.basis: NL2: 'it operates within three different state areas' and 'the UAV swarm continuously performs target search tasks'
segment_coverage.reason: NL2 establishes two independent obligations: a cardinality of three state areas (represented as 'other' since cardinality is not in the allowed category list) and a continuous target search action. Both are captured as separate atomic contracts.

segment_coverage.basis: NL3: 'When the UAV swarm is intercepted, it transitions to the formation adjustment state'
segment_coverage.reason: NL3 establishes a single transition endpoint from the UAV swarm to the formation adjustment state, triggered by interception. The endpoint contract and transition group capture this relation.

segment_coverage.basis: NL4: 'it enters the attack state' and 'the number of UAVs in the swarm decreases accordingly'
segment_coverage.reason: NL4 establishes two independent obligations: a transition endpoint to the attack state (triggered by task assignment information) and a variable delta requiring the UAV count to decrease after attack completion.

alternatives.basis: NL3: 'When the UAV swarm is intercepted, it transitions to the formation adjustment state'

transition_groups.reason: NL3 establishes a single transition relation from the UAV swarm to the formation adjustment state, with interception as the triggering event.

alternatives.basis: NL4: 'During flight, if task assignment information is received, it enters the attack state'
alternatives.reason: The UAV swarm during flight transitions to the attack state when task assignment information is received; receipt of task assignment is the causal event.

transition_groups.reason: NL4 establishes a single transition relation from the UAV swarm during flight to the attack state, with task assignment information as the triggering event.

issues.observed: The FCSTM declares zero actions on any state. SearchingState at line 6 is a composite with child states but no do action. The PlantUML source shows state body descriptions (e.g., 'Target Search State') but no executable do action.
issues.reason: The NL explicitly requires the UAV swarm to 'continuously perform target search tasks' as a do action on its operating scope. The binding hints supply all three S4 inputs (state=SearchingState, phase=do, action=target search tasks). The closed FCSTM has no do action on SearchingState, making this a verifiable missing state action.
issues.requirement_quote: Before the mission is completed, the UAV swarm continuously performs target search tasks, during which it operates within three different state areas.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The PlantUML body text 'Target Search State' on TargetSearchingState could be interpreted as encoding the do action semantically, but it is a description label, not an executable action in the FCSTM formalism. The inspection confirms actions count is zero across the entire model.
issues.title: Missing do action for target search on SearchingState composite

issues.basis: NL4 segment text 'After completing the attack, the number of UAVs in the swarm decreases accordingly'; contract NL-CONTRACT-NL4-VAR-DELTA-1 binding hints (state=attack state, variable=number of UAVs, effect=decreases); inspection_equivalent_facts.transitions[4] effects=[]; reference_inspection_facts inventory_receipts.variables count=0; fcstm_model.text containing no variable declarations.
issues.expected: After the AttackState is completed (transition on Attack_Completed), an effect must decrease the variable representing the number of UAVs in the swarm.
issues.observed: The FCSTM declares zero variables and zero effects across all transitions. The carrier transition transition:line:14 (AttackState -> TargetSearchingState on Attack_Completed) has effects=[] and no variable is declared in the model that could track UAV count.
issues.reason: The NL requires a variable delta (UAV count decreases) upon attack completion. The exact carrier transition is transition:line:14 (AttackState -> TargetSearchingState on Attack_Completed). The FCSTM has no variables declared and no effects on any transition, so the required variable delta is entirely absent. No frozen predicate directly expresses variable_delta, so this remains a predicate-null candidate.
issues.requirement_quote: During flight, if task assignment information is received, it enters the attack state. After completing the attack, the number of UAVs in the swarm decreases accordingly.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The variable delta could be considered an implementation detail outside the state machine's formal scope. However, the NL explicitly states 'the number of UAVs in the swarm decreases accordingly' as a required behavioral consequence of attack completion, making it a model-level obligation that the FCSTM must represent.
issues.title: Missing variable delta effect for UAV count decrease after attack completion

issues.basis: NL-CONTRACT-REF-002 binding hints (state, phase=do, action); FCSTM model text showing no action declarations; reference_inspection_facts actions count=0; inspection_equivalent_facts showing no action fields on any state or transition.
issues.expected: SearchingState (UAV swarm operating scope) has a do activity representing continuous target search tasks, active while the swarm is in any of its three state areas.
issues.observed: The closed model declares zero actions (actions count = 0 in reference_inspection_facts). No do, entry, or exit action exists on SearchingState or any of its child states. The PlantUML body text 'Target Search State' on TargetSearchingState is a label, not a formal do activity.
issues.reason: The NL2 contract requires a do action on the UAV swarm operating scope (SearchingState). The binding hints explicitly supply state='UAV swarm operating scope', phase='do', action='target search tasks'. The closed model has zero declared actions, so the required do activity is absent. S4 is applicable because all three hints (state, phase, action) are explicitly supplied by the NL extraction.
issues.requirement_quote: Before the mission is completed, the UAV swarm continuously performs target search tasks, during which it operates within three different state areas.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The PlantUML body annotation 'Target Search State' on TargetSearchingState could be interpreted as author intent for a do activity. However, in FCSTM the body text was projected into the state name (TargetSearchingState named "TargetSearchingState\n[PlantUML body] Target Search State") rather than as a separate action declaration. The model contains no formal action slot.
issues.title: Do action 'target search tasks' absent from SearchingState composite
